hindi: हे मरुतों के पिता, तुम्हारी कृपा हमारे पास आए; हमें सूर्य के दर्शन से अलग न करो। हमारा वीर घोड़े के सामने टिका रहे; हे रुद्र, हम संतान के साथ आगे उत्पन्न हों।
english: O father of the Maruts, may your favour come to us; do not separate us from the sight of the sun. May our hero hold out against the charger; O Rudra, may we be born forth with offspring.
notes: 'abhi ... arvati kṣameta' is uncertain: arvati is taken as locative of arvant 'charger', abhi as 'against'; the sense 'hold out against the charger' is a literal guess. 'pra jāyemahi' is literally 'may we be born forth'.

hindi: हे रुद्र, तुम्हारे दिए हुए अत्यंत हितकर उपचारों के साथ मैं सौ वर्ष पाऊँ। हमसे द्वेष को दूर करो, और भी दूर करो; संकट को दूर करो; पीड़ाओं को बिखेरकर दूर भगाओ।
english: O Rudra, with the most beneficial remedies given by you, may I attain a hundred winters. Drive hatred away from us, further away; drive away distress; drive off the afflictions, scattering them in all directions.
notes: 'viṣūcīḥ' is taken as 'in different directions', agreeing with amīvāḥ. 'amīvā' is rendered 'affliction' (literally something that afflicts).
lines_deva: त्वाद॑त्तेभी रुद्र॒ शंत॑मेभिः श॒तं हिमा॑ अशीय भेष॒जेभि॑:
व्य१स्मद्द्वेषो॑ वित॒रं व्यंहो॒ व्यमी॑वाश्चातयस्वा॒ विषू॑चीः

hindi: हे रुद्र, तुम उत्पन्न हुओं में तेज से सर्वश्रेष्ठ हो, बलवानों में सबसे बलवान हो, हे वज्र भुजाओं वाले। हमें संकट के पार ले चलो; कल्याण दो; हानि के सब आक्रमणों को दूर रखो।
english: O Rudra, you are the best of the born in splendour, the mightiest of the mighty, O vajra-armed one. Carry us across to the far side of distress; grant well-being; keep away all assaults of harm.
notes: 'abhītī rapasaḥ' is abhītīḥ rapasaḥ by ordinary sandhi (īḥ r- gives ī r-). 'svasti' is taken with the sense 'well-being' as the object of the imperative; the line is elliptical. 'rapas' rendered 'harm'.
lines_deva: श्रेष्ठो॑ जा॒तस्य॑ रुद्र श्रि॒यासि॑ त॒वस्त॑मस्त॒वसां॑ वज्रबाहो

hindi: हे रुद्र, हम तुम्हें प्रणामों से क्रुद्ध न करें, न बुरी स्तुति से, हे वृषभ, न सम्मिलित पुकार से। उपचारों से हमारे वीरों को उठाओ; वैद्यों में तुम्हें सर्वश्रेष्ठ वैद्य सुनता हूँ।
english: O Rudra, may we not anger you with obeisances, nor with ill praise, O bull, nor with joint invocation. Raise up our heroes with remedies; I hear you to be the best physician of physicians.
notes: The first half is uncertain in construction: 'namobhiḥ' (obeisances) as the means of angering is taken literally, in the sense of obeisances wrongly offered; 'sahūtī' (joint invocation) is taken literally. 'śṛṇomi' with accusative 'tvā' is rendered 'I hear (that you are)'; the translation keeps 'hear you to be'.

hindi: जो पुकारों से, हवियों से बुलाया जाता है, उस रुद्र को मैं स्तुतियों से प्रसन्न करूँ। कोमल पेट वाला, सरलता से बुलाया जाने वाला, भूरा, सुंदर ओठों वाला वह हमें इस द्वेष को न सौंपे।
english: Rudra, who is invoked with cries and with oblations, may I appease with praises. Soft-bellied, easy to invoke, tawny, fair-lipped, may he not give us over to this ill will.
notes: 'ava diṣīya' is uncertain: taken as an optative meaning 'may I appease' (ava with a root meaning to bind or appease). 'su-śipra' is rendered 'fair-lipped' (some take it as 'fair-helmeted'). 'manāyai' is uncertain: taken as 'ill will'. 'ṛdūdara' literally 'soft-bellied'.
lines_deva: हवी॑मभि॒र्हव॑ते॒ यो ह॒विर्भि॒रव॒ स्तोमे॑भी रु॒द्रं दि॑षीय

hindi: मरुतों से युक्त वृषभ ने मुझ याचना करने वाले को अधिक बलवान जीवन-शक्ति से प्रसन्न किया है। जैसे ताप से पीड़ित छाया को, वैसे निर्दोष होकर मैं उसे पाऊँ; मैं रुद्र की कृपा को सेवा से पाऊँ।
english: The bull accompanied by the Maruts has gladdened me, who beg, with more vigorous life force. Like one in the heat reaching shade, free from fault may I attain it; may I win Rudra's favour by service.

hindi: हे रुद्र, तुम्हारा वह कृपालु हाथ कहाँ है जो उपचार करने वाला और शीतल करने वाला है? हे वृषभ, तुम दिव्य हानि को दूर करने वाले हो; अब मुझे क्षमा करो।
english: Where is that gracious hand of yours, O Rudra, which is healing and soothing? Remover of divine harm, O bull, now pardon me.
notes: 'jalāṣa' is traditionally 'soothing, cooling'; rendered 'soothing' but uncertain. 'daivyasya rapasaḥ' is rendered 'harm of the gods' (harm coming from the gods is a possible reading). 'abhi ... cakṣamīthāḥ' is taken as 'pardon', form uncertain.

hindi: भूरे वृषभ के लिए, उज्ज्वल के लिए, मैं महान् उत्तम स्तुति भेजता हूँ। उस दीप्तिमान् को प्रणाम करो; प्रणामों के साथ हम रुद्र के प्रचंड नाम की स्तुति करते हैं।
english: To the tawny bull, the bright one, I send forth a great good praise. Do homage to the blazing one; with obeisances we praise the fierce name of Rudra.
notes: 'śvitīce' (bright, white) and 'kalmalīkinam' (blazing) are uncertain; 'maho' is taken as an agreeing dative 'great' but the form is unclear. 'namasyā' may be an imperative 'do homage' or an instrumental 'with homage'; in the latter case the line would read 'we praise the blazing one with homage, with obeisances the fierce name of Rudra'.

english: Worthy, you bear arrows and a bow; worthy, a venerable niṣka of every form. Worthy, you show mercy to all this immensity; none indeed is mightier than you, O Rudra.
notes: 'arhan' is rendered 'worthy' (as is fitting). 'niṣka' is a gold neck ornament; kept as niṣka. 'dayase' (mercy, or apportioning) and 'abhva' (immense, monstrous; here a noun) are uncertain.

english: Praise the renowned one, who sits in the chariot seat, the youth, terrible like a wild beast, the smiter close at hand, the mighty. O Rudra, being praised, be gracious to the singer; let your hosts cut down another than us.

hindi: हे रुद्र, मैं तुम्हारे पास आते हुए की ओर झुका हूँ, जैसे बालक भी अभिवादन किए जाते पिता की ओर झुकता है। प्रचुरता के दाता, सज्जनों के स्वामी की मैं स्तुति करता हूँ; स्तुति पाकर तुम हमें उपचार दो।
english: I have bowed towards you, O Rudra, as you approach, as even a boy bows towards his father who is being greeted. I praise you, the giver of abundance, lord of the good; praised, give us remedies.
notes: Construction of the first line is uncertain: 'kumāraś cit pitaraṃ vandamānam' (a boy bowing to, or greeting, his father) is taken as an implied comparison, and 'prati nānāma ... upayantam' as 'I bowed towards you as you approach'; there is no explicit word for 'as'. hindi: रुद्र का शस्त्र हमसे बचकर निकल जाए; उस प्रचंड की महान् दुर्भावना हमारे पास से गुज़र जाए। हे दानशील, उदार जनों के लिए दृढ़ वस्तुओं को ढीला करो; संतान और वंशज पर कृपा करो।
english: May the missile of Rudra be turned aside from us; may the great ill will of the fierce one pass us by. Slacken the firm ones for the bountiful; O liberal one, be gracious to child and descendant.
notes: 'sthirā' is neuter plural 'firm ones'; the noun is not stated (some take it as the bows). 'hetī' is hetiḥ by sandhi (iḥ r- gives ī r-); the visarga forms 'vṛjyāḥ' and 'durmatiḥ mahī' are read as printed.
lines_deva: परि॑ णो हे॒ती रु॒द्रस्य॑ वृज्या॒: परि॑ त्वे॒षस्य॑ दुर्म॒तिर्म॒ही गा॑त्
अव॑ स्थि॒रा म॒घव॑द्भ्यस्तनुष्व॒ मीढ्व॑स्तो॒काय॒ तन॑याय मृळ
lines_iast: pari̭ ṇo he̱tī ru̱drasya̭ vṛjyā̱: pari̭ tve̱ṣasya̭ durma̱tirma̱hī gā̭t
ava̭ sthi̱rā ma̱ghava̭dbhyastanuṣva̱ mīḍhva̭sto̱kāya̱ tana̭yāya mṛḻa

hindi: इसी प्रकार, हे भूरे वृषभ, हे सजग देव, जिससे तुम न क्रुद्ध हो और न प्रहार करो। हे पुकार सुनने वाले रुद्र, यहाँ हमारी ओर ध्यान दो; हम उत्तम वीरों से युक्त होकर यज्ञ में महान् रूप से बोलें।
english: So, O tawny bull, O attentive god, that you may neither be angry nor strike. Hearer of invocations, O Rudra, take heed of us here; may we, rich in heroes, speak greatly in the rite.
notes: 'bṛhad vadema' is the refrain of this hymn group; 'bṛhat' is literally 'great', rendered 'greatly' (often taken as 'loudly'). The first line is a purpose clause that depends on a verb not stated in it.
lines_deva: ए॒वा ब॑भ्रो वृषभ चेकितान॒ यथा॑ देव॒ न हृ॑णी॒षे न हंसि॑
ह॒व॒न॒श्रुन्नो॑ रुद्रे॒ह बो॑धि बृ॒हद् व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीरा॑:
lines_iast: e̱vā ba̭bhro vṛṣabha cekitāna̱ yathā̭ deva̱ na hṛ̭ṇī̱ṣe na haṃsi̭
ha̱va̱na̱śrunno̭ rudre̱ha bo̭dhi bṛ̱had va̭dema vi̱dathḙ su̱vīrā̭:
